title: LYA Plan (a multi-step goal)
description: What the owner approves once (ADR-002). plan_hash covers steps, tools, targets and tiers; any deviation re-escalates. A model may PROPOSE a plan but never authorises one (D-2).

expected.description: What success looks like - used by VERIFY (07-NEURAL-SCHEMA.md step 8).

needs_approval.description: true if any step's tier is OWNER.

plan_hash.description: Stable hash of steps+tools+targets+tiers. The approval is bound to THIS string.

validated_by.description: Optional typed-decision check (JEV-class): 'does any step leave the approved tool set?' - advisory only.
